meta.title: Haymaca — Jamaica trips, planned on the ground
meta.description: A Kingston travel studio arranging private and small-group trips across Jamaica: Treasure Beach, Port Antonio, the Blue Mountains, Frenchman's Cove. Enquiries answered by a person within one working day.

a11y.decorativeRidge: Silhouette of the Blue Mountain ridge

brand.name: Haymaca
brand.meaning: Taíno for "land of wood and water" — the island's older name.

hero.body: We book the fishing boat, not the catamaran. Private and small-group trips across the island, planned around what you actually want to do — and answered by a person, not a form.
hero.priceNote: Trips from USD $2,400 per person (about J$375,000), flights excluded.

enquiry.title: Tell us the shape of the trip
enquiry.subtitle: Three questions now, the details later. No account, no payment.
enquiry.submitHint: Opens WhatsApp with your answers filled in. We reply within one working day.
enquiry.waMessage: Hi Haymaca — I'd like to plan a Jamaica trip. Where: {where}. When: {when}. Travelling: {party}.
enquiry.validation: Choose a starting point so we know where to begin.

destinations.title: Where we send people
destinations.intro: Four places we know street by street. Every trip is built from stays we have slept in and boats we have been on — not a supplier list.

treasure-beach.name: Treasure Beach
treasure-beach.blurb: Fishing villages on the dry side of the island. Community-run guesthouses, a boat out to the Pelican Bar, and not a resort strip in sight.

port-antonio.name: Port Antonio
port-antonio.blurb: The green corner. Bamboo rafting down the Rio Grande, the Blue Lagoon before the boats arrive, and waterfalls you reach on foot.

blue-mountains.name: Blue Mountains
blue-mountains.blurb: Coffee farms at 1,200 metres, cold nights under blankets, and the pre-dawn walk to the 2,256-metre Peak for sunrise over both coasts.

frenchmans-cove.name: Frenchman's Cove
frenchmans-cove.blurb: A white-sand cove where a cold freshwater river runs straight into the sea. You can swim in both within one stroke.

process.title: How an enquiry becomes a trip

one.title: You send three lines
one.body: Where, roughly when, how many. That is enough for us to start building.

two.title: We reply with a real plan
two.body: Within one working day: named stays, a day-by-day outline and a price in USD. A proposal, not a brochure.

three.title: We adjust until it fits
three.body: Swap a guesthouse, add a rafting day, move the dates. Nothing is booked until you say so.

contact.title: Talk to a person
contact.body: Weekdays 8am–6pm Jamaica time. WhatsApp is usually the fastest way to reach us.
contact.whatsappMessage: Hi Haymaca — I have a question about planning a trip.

meta.title: Tours and day trips — Haymaca
meta.description: Guided day trips and multi-day routes across Jamaica, filterable by category, duration, price and date, on a grid or a map.

tours.title: Tours and day trips
tours.intro: Guided days out and multi-day routes across the island, run by people from these parishes. Filter by what you want to do, when you can go, and what you want to spend.

empty.title: No tours match those filters
empty.body: Widen the dates or drop a filter — the calendar fills months ahead, so there is usually something close.

blue-mountain-peak-sunrise.title: Blue Mountain Peak sunrise hike
blue-mountain-peak-sunrise.summary: A pre-dawn climb to 2,256 m for sunrise above the clouds.

rio-grande-rafting.title: Rio Grande bamboo rafting
rio-grande-rafting.summary: Two hours poled downriver on a bamboo raft, Portland's old banana route.

pelican-bar-boat.title: Pelican Bar by boat
pelican-bar-boat.summary: A boat to the stilted sandbar bar a mile off Parottee, with lunch out at sea.

reach-falls-hike.title: Reach Falls river walk
reach-falls-hike.summary: Climb the tiered falls and swim the jade pools in Portland's rainforest.

kingston-heritage-walk.title: Kingston heritage walk
kingston-heritage-walk.summary: Trench Town, the Marley museum and downtown on foot with a local guide.

appleton-rum-estate.title: Appleton Estate rum day
appleton-rum-estate.summary: The Nassau Valley distillery, cane field to cask, with a guided tasting.

cockpit-birding.title: Cockpit Country birding
cockpit-birding.summary: Dawn among the sinkhole hills for endemic parrots and the swallowtail.

blue-lagoon-swim.title: Blue Lagoon swim
blue-lagoon-swim.summary: The spring-fed lagoon where cold fresh water meets the warm sea.

black-river-safari.title: Black River safari
black-river-safari.summary: A boat up the island's longest river, past crocodiles and mangrove.

blue-mountain-coffee.title: Blue Mountain coffee farm
blue-mountain-coffee.summary: A working farm at 1,200 m: picking, roasting and a cup at the source.

island-traverse-7day.title: Seven-day island traverse
island-traverse-7day.summary: Coast to mountains to coast: the south shore, the Peak and Portland in a week.

accompong-maroon.title: Accompong Maroon village
accompong-maroon.summary: The free Maroon town in the Cockpit hills, its history told by its own people.

south-coast-3day.title: South coast in three days
south-coast-3day.summary: Treasure Beach, Pelican Bar and YS Falls at a slow southern pace.

book.title: Book
book.noDepartures: No dated departures right now. Send an enquiry and we will arrange one.

errors.sold_out: Those seats just went. Pick another departure.
errors.hold_invalid: Your hold expired. Choose a departure to start again.
errors.departure_cancelled: That departure is no longer running. Pick another.
errors.invalid: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.network: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

validation.name: Enter the lead traveller's name.
validation.phone: Enter a phone number we can reach you on.

checkout.title: Deposit payment
checkout.hostedNote: Card details are entered on {provider}'s secure page — they never reach Haymaca.

status.confirmedBody: Your deposit is paid and your seats are held. A confirmation and e-ticket are on their way to {email}.
status.pendingBody: We have not seen the deposit yet. If you have just paid, this page updates in a moment.
status.failedTitle: The payment did not go through
status.failedBody: No deposit was taken. You can start the booking again.
status.expiredBody: The 15-minute hold ran out before the deposit cleared, so we did not rebook you automatically. The next departure with room:
status.expiredNoNext: There is no later departure with room right now — send an enquiry and we will find you a place.
status.cancelledCustomer: This booking was cancelled at your request.
status.cancelledWeather: This departure was cancelled for weather. Your deposit is being refunded.
status.cancelWithin: Free cancellation up to 7 days before departure.
status.eticketBody: Show this QR at check-in — the operator scans it to confirm your place.
status.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and reload.

book.requirements: Anything we should know? (diet, mobility, ages)
book.requirementsHint: Optional — this goes straight to your guide.

operator.loginBody: Enter the operator passcode to see today's manifests.
operator.title: Departures
operator.cancelWeatherConfirm: Cancel this departure for weather? Every guest is refunded and notified.
operator.scanBody: Point the camera at an e-ticket, or paste a token. Works offline — scans queue and sync when you are back online.
operator.resultNotConfirmed: Ticket is not for a confirmed booking
operator.resultWrongDeparture: Ticket is for a different departure
operator.cameraUnavailable: Camera not available — paste the token instead.

notFound.title: That page has drifted off the map
notFound.body: The page you asked for is not here. The coastline, though, is exactly where you left it.
